🌿 Team PAN — Ecology & Environmental Protection

We are developing the environmental section of the PAN & DAPHNIS educational app for students of natural sciences. Our AI mentor, Pan, helps users explore ecosystems, biodiversity, environmental protection, and field research. The app provides personalized learning resources, practical tasks, scientific information, and tools for environmental monitoring.

### DAPHNIS — Your Agricultural Mentor

DAPHNIS is an interactive educational platform designed to make agricultural and environmental education more accessible, practical, and engaging. Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, our project combines **learning, hands-on practice, and interactive tools** in one digital environment.

The platform offers six agronomy learning modules, quizzes, a field journal, seed-rate calculations, access to NASA POWER climate data, and an interactive digital mentor named DAPHNIS, who helps students understand agricultural concepts and make informed decisions.

Our project addresses the challenge of connecting Earth observation data with real-world agricultural knowledge. By combining NASA climate information with agronomic education, DAPHNIS helps students explore how environmental conditions affect crops, soil health, and sustainable farming practices.

**DAPHNIS is important because it bridges the gap between theory and practice**, encourages data-driven thinking, and prepares future agricultural specialists to respond to climate change and environmental challenges.

Our goal is to make agricultural education smarter, more interactive, and accessible to everyone.
details:
DAPHNIS — Your Agricultural Mentor

DAPHNIS is an interactive educational platform that combines learning, practical experience, and interactive technology to make agricultural and environmental education more accessible and engaging.

How Does It Work?

Our platform provides a digital environment where students can explore agricultural science, practice essential skills, and learn how environmental data influences farming decisions.

DAPHNIS includes six interactive agronomy courses covering soil science, crop production, plant nutrition, crop protection, crop rotation, and climate adaptation. Students can test their knowledge through quizzes and track their learning progress.

The platform also integrates NASA POWER climate data, allowing users to request real environmental information and explore climate conditions relevant to agriculture.

Additional features include a digital field journal, CSV data export, a seed-rate calculator, and an interactive learning assistant named DAPHNIS. Our illustrated character guides students through agricultural concepts and makes the learning experience more engaging.

What Benefits Does It Offer?

DAPHNIS connects theoretical knowledge with practical applications. Instead of simply reading about agriculture, students can interact with educational materials, perform calculations, explore environmental data, and develop analytical skills.

The platform encourages independent learning, environmental awareness, and data-driven thinking. It also introduces students to NASA's publicly available scientific resources.

What Is the Intended Impact?

Our goal is to help educate a new generation of agricultural specialists who understand the importance of sustainable farming, soil conservation, and climate adaptation.

By making scientific information easier to understand, DAPHNIS aims to bridge the gap between classroom education and real-world agricultural challenges.

In the future, we plan to expand the platform with advanced geospatial analysis, interactive field maps, and improved agricultural decision-support tools.

What Technologies Did We Use?

We developed the website using:

  • HTML5 to build the platform's structure.
  • CSS3 to create a responsive, nature-inspired interface.
  • JavaScript to implement interactive lessons, quizzes, calculations, and other functionality.
  • NASA POWER API to retrieve environmental and climate data.
  • Browser localStorage to save learning progress and field journal entries.
  • CSV export to allow users to download field records.
  • WebP digital illustrations to integrate our original characters into the platform.

The project runs in a standard web browser and does not require specialized hardware.

What Makes DAPHNIS Creative?

Our project combines scientific data, agricultural education, and character-based interaction in a single digital experience.

One of its distinctive features is DAPHNIS, our illustrated digital agricultural mentor, designed to create a friendly connection between students and educational technology.

The interface uses natural colors, approachable visual elements, and interactive learning activities to make complex agricultural topics easier to explore.

What Factors Did Our Team Consider?

During development, we focused on accessibility, educational value, ease of use, environmental sustainability, and the practical needs of students.

We also considered the importance of distinguishing real scientific data from demonstration content. For example, NASA POWER charts initially show sample data until users request actual values, while the digital mentor currently uses predefined responses rather than a generative AI model.

Our team wanted to create a platform that is realistic, expandable, and useful for agricultural education.

DAPHNIS is more than a website — it is a step toward a future where education, technology, and environmental knowledge work together to support smarter and more sustainable agriculture.
